meta.title: Tourmaline end-member sweep (layer two / tourbillon tourmaline component)
meta.note: Same recipe for every end-member (phi 0.20, binder, eps_r 7 [est], aligned upper bound); only the tourmaline coefficients change. No source: every field is zero by design (zero-run acceptance). The synthetic block applies the same stress, dT and field to each end-member.
meta.magnetic_flag: schorl is iron-bearing and paramagnetic (Fe2+ on the Y site): it adds a magnetic coupling that elbaite lacks. A feature if the layer is meant to couple to the magnetic field, a confound if the electric (piezo/pyro/electrocaloric) response is being isolated. Not coupled in the solver (B = 0).

elbaite.chi_tag: [lit Sigamony 1944, rose tourmaline 0.58e-6 cgs; elbaite proxy, UNSURE]

schorl.p_tag: [lit Hawkins 1995 Table 5, ideal schorl FeO 20.46 wt%, +-0.6]

electric_march.equation: eps dE/dt + sigma E = -dP/dt - J_src; J_src = 0 (no-drive stub); E(0) = 0; implicit Euler on the thermal time grid
electric_march.sources: P = pyroelectric polarization (layer two, BTO; aligned upper bound eta = 1); piezo enters as the phasor at each mode's own frequency, summed over all l=0 shell modes; electrocaloric heat -> thermal, entropy -> chemical

piezo_layer2.route: acoustic stress -> electric holster (polarization / energy density in the layer; no circuit)
